definitions.explanation: Describes someone with a strong, muscular build suggesting physical power. Often used for men with imposing physiques.

examples.japanese: {屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧
{屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A burly security guard was standing there.

examples.japanese: {屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}んでいた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: Muscular young men were carrying the luggage.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧.

NUANCE: {屈強|くっきょう} emphasizes muscular, powerful build - the visual impression of physical strength. It's typically used for men and suggests an imposing physique rather than just good health.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧ (brawny man)
- {屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧ (sturdy build)
- {屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧ (muscular youth)
- {屈強|くっきょう}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ (powerful body)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦たくましい→たくましい：06255_takumashii⟧ (sturdy, robust - more common)
- ⟦{頑健|がんけん}→頑健：09197_ganken⟧ (sturdy, robust - more about health)
- ⟦がっしり→がっしり：19940_gasshiri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ (solidly built)
- {筋骨|きんこつ}{隆々|りゅうりゅう} (muscular, brawny)
